scientific_integrity: The original equal-multiplier strategy and unlimited-horizon limit are credited to Kuszmaul. The new claim is matching finite-horizon global optimality, optimizer uniqueness, and the sharp N^-1 budget gap. Finite program checks supplement a universal analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: Toy discrete-time fair betting with bounded target and proportional downside; no financial-market predictive validity; uniqueness only when L>1; independent priority assessment not performed; Yao 2007 full text inaccessible.
title: Exact finite-horizon success frontier for leveraged fair gambling
